bitcoin_articles.headline: BitGo Launches Institutional Bitcoin Staking with Stacks
bitcoin_articles.summary: BitGo Bank & Trust has introduced a new institutional Bitcoin staking service that allows clients to earn rewards by bonding STX tokens.

bitcoin_articles.headline: CleanSpark CEO Outlines Strategic Focus on Power Load Security
bitcoin_articles.summary: CleanSpark CEO Matt Schultz clarified the company's strategic shift, emphasizing the use of Bitcoin mining as a tool to secure large power loads and utilizing Bitcoin holdings as a capital asset.

bitcoin_articles.headline: Hyperscale Data Reports Cash and Bitcoin Holdings as of November 1, 2026
bitcoin_articles.summary: Hyperscale Data, Inc. announced that as of November 1, 2026, it held approximately $50.6 million in total liquidity, consisting of 211.4639 Bitcoin and $34.1 million in cash and restricted cash.

bitcoin_articles.headline: Keefe Bruyette Adjusts Price Targets for AI Infrastructure Stocks
bitcoin_articles.summary: Keefe Bruyette & Woods (KBW) updated its price targets for several companies in the Bitcoin mining and AI hosting sector, including a target price adjustment for Keel Infrastructure Corp.

bitcoin_articles.headline: London BTC Company Announces Assay Results from Black Star Gold-Silver Project
bitcoin_articles.summary: London BTC Company Limited reported positive gold and silver assay results from its Black Star Project in Nevada, including surface gold grades reaching 43.38 g/t.

bitcoin_articles.headline: Tap Global Group plc Announces Further Digital Asset Purchases for Treasury Reserve
bitcoin_articles.summary: Tap Global Group plc has expanded its Digital Asset Income Strategy (DAIS) treasury reserve with additional purchases of Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Solana.

bitcoin_articles.headline: Bitdeer Technologies Group Reports Zero Bitcoin Holdings Following Weekly Production Sale
bitcoin_articles.summary: Bitdeer Technologies Group sold its entire weekly production of 265.5 BTC, resulting in zero bitcoin holdings as of October 30, 2026, excluding customer deposits.
